newsitem.title: USA: Putnam Investments names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Putnam Investments names chief financial officer.

text.p: Putman Investments on Friday said it named Irene Esteves as managing director, chief financial officer and a member of the management committee, effective January 13.
Esteves will replace Douglas Jamieson, who is retiring in late 1997, the company said.
She would be responsible for all corporate financial functions, including planning and analysis, accounting, control, audit, treasury, tax and internal and external reporting, the company said.
Esteves was most recently vice president of corporate strategy and international finance at Miller Brewing, a unit of Philip Morris Cos Inc, in Milwaukee.
The money management firm said it managed more than $170 billion for over six million individuals and over 450 institutional clients.
